title: CrossFill mapping
description: Describes a target web form for CrossFill: where it is and which CSS selector holds each field.

target_url.description: URL of the page that contains the target form.

form_selector.description: CSS selector of the one form to fill. Elements outside it (login pop-ups, newsletters) are never touched.

fields.description: Field name -> CSS selector inside form_selector. Fields left out are found by automatic matching.

source.description: Where to read data from when the source is a web page.

synonyms.description: Extra words the automatic matcher should look for, per field. Checked before the built-in synonyms.
